name: mkdir
title: Create a directory
description: Creates one or more directories with optional parent path creation.

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Create intermediate parent directories as needed without reporting an error if they exist.

flags.name: -v
flags.description: Print a message for each created directory (POSIX).

examples.explanation: Creates a directory named 'project' in the current working directory.
Creates nested directories including parents if they do not exist.

risk.sideEffects: Allocates a new filesystem directory inode.

name: New-Item
title: Create a directory or file (PowerShell)
description: Native PowerShell cmdlet to create folders, files, or registry keys.

flags.name: -ItemType
flags.description: Specifies the provider-specified type of the new item ('Directory', 'File', etc.).

flags.name: -Force
flags.description: Creates items that write over read-only items or creates parent directories.

examples.explanation: Creates a folder named 'build' in the current path.
Recursively creates the utils directory structure.

risk.sideEffects: Creates a new item on the filesystem.

name: rm
title: Remove files or directories
description: Removes each specified file or directory. By default does not remove directories without recursive flag.

flags.name: -r
flags.description: Remove directories and their contents recursively.

flags.name: -f
flags.description: Force removal; ignore nonexistent files and arguments, never prompt.

flags.name: -i
flags.description: Prompt before every removal.

examples.explanation: Removes file.txt.
Recursively and forcefully deletes the node_modules folder.

risk.sideEffects: Permanently unlinks files from the filesystem without moving to trash.

name: Remove-Item
title: Remove items in PowerShell
description: PowerShell cmdlet that deletes files, folders, and registry keys.

flags.name: -Recurse
flags.description: Deletes the items in the specified locations and in all child items.

flags.name: -Force
flags.description: Allows the cmdlet to remove items that cannot otherwise be changed, such as hidden or read-only files.

examples.explanation: Recursively deletes the 'dist' directory and all its contents.

name: ls
title: List directory contents
description: Lists information about files and directories in the current or specified path.

flags.name: -l
flags.description: Use long listing format showing permissions, owner, size, and modification date.

flags.name: -a
flags.description: Do not ignore entries starting with . (hidden files).

flags.name: -h
flags.description: With -l, print sizes in human readable format (e.g., 1K 234M 2G).

examples.explanation: Lists all files including hidden ones with human-readable sizes and full permissions.

name: cp
title: Copy files and directories
description: Copies files or directories from source to destination.

flags.name: -r
flags.description: Copy directories recursively.

flags.name: -i
flags.description: Prompt before overwrite.

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Preserve specified attributes such as mode, ownership, timestamps.

examples.explanation: Copies an example config to a new .env file.
Recursively copies the entire src directory to src_backup.

risk.sideEffects: Creates duplicate files or overwrites existing destination files.
risk.reversibility: Destination overwrites cannot be undone automatically.

name: mv
title: Move or rename files and directories
description: Moves files or directories, or renames them if source and target are on the same filesystem.

flags.name: -i
flags.description: Prompt before overwrite.

flags.name: -f
flags.description: Do not prompt before overwriting.

examples.explanation: Renames old_name.txt to new_name.txt.
Moves document.pdf into the archive directory.

risk.sideEffects: Changes file path or overwrites destination.
risk.reversibility: Can be reversed if destination did not overwrite an existing file.

name: pwd
title: Print working directory
description: Prints the full pathname of the current working directory.

flags.name: -P
flags.description: Print the physical directory, without any symbolic links.

examples.explanation: Outputs the absolute path of the current directory.

name: cd
title: Change working directory
description: Changes the current working directory of the shell execution environment.

examples.explanation: Navigates to the parent directory.
Navigates to the user's home directory.

name: chmod
title: Change file mode bits / permissions
description: Changes the file mode bits of each given file according to mode.

flags.name: +x
flags.description: Add execute permission for all users.

flags.name: -R
flags.description: Change files and directories recursively.

examples.explanation: Grants executable permissions to build.sh.
Sets private key permissions readable and writable only by the owner.

name: touch
title: Change file timestamps / create empty file
description: Update the access and modification times of each file to the current time. Creates an empty file if it does not exist.

examples.explanation: Creates an empty file named README.md if it does not already exist.

risk.sideEffects: Creates new file or updates file timestamps.
risk.reversibility: Can delete file if newly created.

name: find
title: Search for files in a directory hierarchy
description: Searches the directory tree rooted at each given starting-point by evaluating the given expression.

flags.name: -name
flags.description: Base of file name matches shell pattern.

flags.name: -type
flags.description: File is of type: d (directory), f (regular file).

flags.name: -size
flags.description: File uses n units of space (e.g. +100M for larger than 100 megabytes).

examples.explanation: Finds all TypeScript files in current directory tree.
Finds all files larger than 100 megabytes.
